title: Grilled Saskatoon Berry Skewers with Outdoor Croatian Twist
description: A sweet and savory summer treat featuring fresh Saskatoon berries, marinated in a zesty outdoor-inspired Croatian sauce and grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Outdoor Croatian sauce
ingredients.notes: see below for ingredients and instructions

instructions: Thread Saskatoon berries, pineapple chunks, red onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together Outdoor Croatian sauce ingredients (see below).
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with Outdoor Croatian sauce.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until vegetables are tender.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Saskatoon berries if desired.
